use_cases: Downloading software or files with real-time progress indication
Providing visual feedback during file download operations in web applications
Handling multiple download states (idle, downloading, downloaded, complete) in a single component
Replacing generic buttons with purpose-built download controls in SaaS dashboards
Creating interactive download experiences with loading animations
ai_summary: A specialized download button component with built-in progress tracking and multiple status states. Features smooth transitions between idle, downloading, and downloaded states with a visible progress bar fill animation. Includes loading spinner and checkmark icons for clear user feedback. Designed for file download workflows in SaaS and web applications.
